hub.speaker: Dresk
hub.text: Sergeant Ashgrave. If you're here to report something, the slate's on the wall. Write it plain.

text_variants._comment: Authored FIRST deliberately: last-match-wins, so quest-status greetings (Pell etc.) override the standing cold line.
text_variants.text: Heard what you've been studying. Keep it out of my barracks and off my streets, and you and I stay civil.
Still no word from Pell. Kit's counted twice over on account of it. Slate stays open till someone finds them.
Pell's back on the roster, thanks to you. Kit's counted, slate's closed. Good day, officially, this time.

options.text: I found Pell. Safe, just turned around.

explain.speaker: Dresk
explain.text: Pell. Green, keen, checks every noise personally instead of logging it and moving on. Went to look at scratching in the drainage gallery two musters back. Hasn't reported since. Not panicking. Yet.

thanks.speaker: Dresk
thanks.text: Turned around, not hurt. That's the good version of this story. Four gold, out of my own kit budget — the Guild doesn't pay for finding my own people. Pell owes you a drink they can't afford yet.
